name: tenkacloud-ac26-crypto-battle-dev
description: Local development harness for the PROVE / LEAK / HUNT Battle. Runs the REAL ../game/src reducer and the REAL ../portal slot components in a browser with no AWS credentials and no network, so UI and game-loop changes can be checked in seconds instead of through a deploy. NOT the competition trust boundary -- see README.md. Its own package (rather than a script inside ../game) because ../game/package.json declares itself a pure game model with no server: this directory is where the server, the bundler, and the fake portal host live so that claim stays true.
